parked.spanish: Este estatuto de la torá que mandó Jehová, diciendo: Habla a hijos de Israel, y tomen a ti vaca roja íntegra, que no hay en ella tacha, que no subió sobre ella yugo.

findings.issue: הַתּוֹרָה is a common noun (instruction/law), left as the untranslated lemma torá.
Feminine demonstrative זאת is smoothed to masculine Este to agree with Spanish estatuto.

parked.spanish: Y lavará el recogente la ceniza de la vaca sus vestidos, y se impurecerá hasta la tarde; y será a hijos de Israel y al peregrino el peregrinante en medio de ellos a estatuto de siempre.

findings.issue: Bare objects assign la ceniza and sus vestidos to lavará. The definite qal participle can govern the first את, with את בגדיו as the object of כבס.
findings.spanishSpan: lavará el recogente la ceniza de la vaca sus vestidos

findings.issue: Unmarked se is a pronominal inchoative. The qal weqatal licenses that he is or becomes unclean, without a reflexive object.
la tarde often means afternoon in current Latin American Spanish; the definite noun is the evening.
peregrino and peregrinante can add pilgrimage travel. H1616 and the H1481 participle license a sojourner who resides.

parked.spanish: Todo el tocante en muerto, en alma del adam que muera, y no se pecará, el mishkán de Jehová impureció, y será cortada el alma aquella desde Israel, porque aguas de nidá no fueron echadas sobre él; impuro será; todavía su impureza en él.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is rendered with Spanish subjunctive muera; person and number stay, mood is smoothing.
Common noun האדם (article + Ncmsa, H120) is left as untranslated adam instead of a Spanish common noun.
Hithpael imperfect 3ms of H2398 is rendered se pecará, reflexive of the qal ‘sin’ sense; that stem’s force is purify oneself, not commit sin.
Common noun משכן (Ncmsc, H4908) is left as untranslated mishkán instead of a Spanish common noun.
את marks משכן as object of piel perfect 3ms טמא (the toucher defiles it). el mishkán … impureció reads as the dwelling doing the defiling.
Common noun נדה (Ncfsa, H5079) is left as untranslated nidá instead of a Spanish common noun.
Qal perfect 3ms active זרק (someone did not throw the waters) is rendered feminine plural passive fueron echadas, with the waters as subject.

parked.spanish: Y varón que se impurezca y no se pecará, y será cortada el alma aquella desde medio de la asamblea, porque el mikdash de Jehová impureció; aguas de nidá no fueron echadas sobre él; impuro él.

findings.issue: Hithpael imperfect 3ms of H2398 licenses the man purifying himself; «se pecará» states reflexive sinning and changes stem force.
Piel perfect 3ms with את has the man defiling the sanctuary as object; «el mikdash de Jehová impureció» makes the sanctuary the subject and drops that object role.
מקדש (H4720) is a common noun left as the untranslated dump mikdash.
זרק is qal perfect 3ms active with מי as the fronted object; «fueron echadas» is feminine plural passive and makes the waters the subject.
נדה (H5079) is a common noun left as the untranslated dump nidá.
Qal imperfect 3ms is indicative; subjunctive «se impurezca» is mood smoothing in the relative clause.

parked.spanish: Y será a ellos a estatuto de siempre; y el rociante aguas de la nidá lavará sus vestidos, y el tocante en aguas de la nidá se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: הַנִּדָּה is a common noun (H5079), not a name; «nidá» leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
Qal imperfect 3ms is a stative/inchoative «be/become unclean»; «se impurecerá» is pronominal smoothing and does not change the participant.
